violations.msg: Per-pin silk labels promised by architecture (GND/3V3/SWDIO/SWCLK and GND/3V3/TX/RX) are absent on the two owner-hand-wired headers; only refdes + pin-1 square pad/dot exist. Consequence: pin-order or SWD-vs-UART mixup when hand-wiring the bare board (3V3/GND swap risk). Fix: add eight text items along the top edge at P9.

The 6 check_silk misattributed refdes are real and four are also covered by parts after assembly (R1/R2 under the J1 shell, C10 inside the U2 body outline, D1 inside U1's outline); D2 reads as C3's label, R10 as D10's; C13's label is cut off from its part by the top slot and crowds H2. Consequence: rework/debug misidentifies parts (assembly unaffected - CPL-driven). Fix: one place_edit.py move_text batch at P9; do not waive.

Sensor tongue outer face (x=54.75, y 38.05-44.95) is a board edge JLC's internal panelizer may land a break-off tab on; snap force through the tongue root while U3 rides the beam. Tongue is stubby (5.5 x 6.9 mm root, aspect < 1) so this is tab-placement only. Fix: JLC order remark at P9 'no break-off tabs / mouse bites on the right-edge sensor tongue', alongside the owed Sensirion no-wash remark.

warnings_triage.verdict: real - fix at P9 (see silk_misattributed_batch), warning severity stands, no waiver

justified - Type-C TC2.0 10 uF attach limit is a binding CAP RULE in constraints.json; the 10 uF bulk (C2) deliberately lives one series element downstream on +5V; nothing draws current from VBUS itself

waiver_review.verdict: RATIFY recommended - model anchors independently recomputed (144.4 C/W where AMS measured 80; 123.3 where TI measured 84), 810.9 mm2 uncredited B.Cu GND spreader verified present, Tj arithmetic checks (82.8 C governing / 109.7 C abuse vs 125 C limit), pass-area 446.8 mm2 exceeds the 439.9 mm2 whole-board ceiling
